title: BioModStack ONT FASTQ-QC bounded result projection v1
x-bms-cross-field-invariants: authority.declared_artifact_count equals the full artifact total; page count equals the returned artifacts length
authority.declared_artifact_count equals authority.present_artifact_count plus authority.unavailable_artifact_count
full inventory state counts equal authority counts; each page contains no more of each state than its declared total
every present artifact URL contains the exact encoded job.id and opaque artifact_id, not the file sha256
alignment_readiness is ready if and only if at least one alignment session is ready
read_length_histogram bins are contiguous half-open fixed_width_v1 bins beginning at zero and sum(read_count) equals source_row_count

coverage points retain one producer reference and strict ascending 1-based order; bucket_width_rows follows ceil(source_row_count/1024); each bucket retains earliest tied minimum and maximum; reported minimum_depth equals the source global minimum
summary, alignment, verification.summary, alignment sessions, coverage, and reference authority identify one exact reference name and length
verification.summary.variant_count equals the full variant total; page count equals returned variants length
each variant record and affected interval follow vcf_left_anchored_v1 kind/ref/alt semantics; insertion intervals are between_bases and cross-origin records are rejected
stages contain the four canonical entries once and in canonical order
encoded UTF-8 compact JSON size is at most 262144 bytes
all JSON numbers are finite
wire validator recomputes coverage projection digest and validates construction attestation without claiming access to omitted source rows
artifact metadata follows the descriptor schema; unavailable artifacts may retain disposition and extension hints but have no usable URL or byte identity
artifact display_order is a positive presentation order, not a page-local index
missing_required and not_produced artifacts remain visibly unavailable without hiding readable results
execution resource observations are either accepted, historical_unavailable or unavailable; invalid observations do not gate scientific results
stage states and output counts are reported as observed, not compared with historical fixed counts

threshold_profile.sha256 equals SHA-256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON of threshold_profile.values using sorted keys, separators comma and colon, allow_nan false; outer version, calibration_status, and public_accuracy_validated equal values
verification verdict and reasons are preserved from the producer, including FAIL for failed scientific checks
verification verdict PASS requires every check pass, empty aggregate and row reason codes, automatic_pass_eligible true, public_accuracy_validated true, and all profile thresholds satisfied
decision metrics are optional and additive; unavailable observations remain null, never fabricated success-only values
present artifact URL final segment equals artifact_id and artifact_id differs from file sha256
source_reads_fastq alone has owner_scope managed_input_snapshot; every other descriptor has owner_scope result_root
managed-input artifact authority resolves exact persisted input snapshot without result-root containment; result artifacts resolve no-follow beneath exact Job result root
